# nada

> Wav2vec 2.0 speech recognition on Modular MAX

[Wav2vec 2.0](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.11477) on [Modular MAX](https://docs.modular.com/max/). This is the base model fine-tuned on 960 hours of LibriSpeech for character-level CTC: a convolutional feature encoder, a convolutional position embedding, and a 12-layer transformer, with a linear head that scores 32 characters for every 20 ms of audio. The weights are the Hugging Face release `facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h`.

The layout follows `solid_lens`. `config` is the architecture, `weights` binds a checkpoint, and `compile_model` traces the module for one batch size and one clip length. The graph is a MAX module (`max.experimental.nn`): the same `forward` runs eagerly or compiled. Module and parameter names match the Hugging Face implementation, so its state dict loads without renaming.

## Modules

- [nada.audio](https://alix559.github.io/nada/audio.html.md): Wav2vec 2.0 encoder, as `Wav2Vec2Model` runs it at inference.
- [nada.config](https://alix559.github.io/nada/config.html.md): Shapes for the wav2vec 2.0 base checkpoint.
- [nada.download](https://alix559.github.io/nada/download.html.md): Download `facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h` and write a numpy checkpoint.
- [nada.features](https://alix559.github.io/nada/features.html.md): Waveform preparation and CTC decoding for the wav2vec 2.0 checkpoint.
- [nada.layers](https://alix559.github.io/nada/layers.html.md): Building blocks the MAX graph needs that are not in `max.experimental.nn`.
- [nada.model](https://alix559.github.io/nada/model.html.md): Wav2vec 2.0 with a CTC head.
- [nada.parity](https://alix559.github.io/nada/parity.html.md): Compare the MAX graph with Hugging Face on a tiny wav2vec 2.0 of the same weights.
- [nada.weights](https://alix559.github.io/nada/weights.html.md): Load a wav2vec 2.0 state dict onto the MAX module.
